author: Mira Laverdure
text: Michelle handles every call with professionalism and her customer service is outstanding, I had an issue inside my house, she was able to recommend somebody for me to call to come fix it. We are very satisfied, everything worked out well. This local family business is definitely worth calling for all of your septic and drain needs!!

author: Nicole C
text: These guys just finished installing a new septic and leeching field at our new home, we didn't hire them because the previous owner was responsible for it but we're thankful he chose them! They are family run and all of the brothers were so nice, they did a great job and leveled the front yard so well. We had some large rocks that he was also able to place perfectly to fit in with the landscape. It was a unique situation because we weren't the ones paying but they did a great job of communicating and keeping us in the loop. We will be using them from here on out to maintain our system!

author: Sachin Patel
text: This review is long overdue; however it was delayed on purpose.  We had some major drainage issues at the home and had hired Boraczek's Septic & Drain to help address the issue.  Now, when you're doing work like this, it's hard to write a review before you have a good amount time to pass so that you can ensure what was done actually worked.  Well, here I am 2 years later and boy did it work.  From the moment they came to my property, I felt comfortable.  It's a family business and they really made you feel comfortable with the process.  They answered my calls & texts and more importantly showed up on time.  We've been hit with some tremendous rain fall this year and our yard is bone dry and so is our basement.  All downspouts from the gutter lead away from the home and with the amount of crushed stone put in the various trenches they dug, it just works..all of it just works.  Truly thankful to have found their information...just a wonderful experience.

author: Chris Denmore
text: My septic system backed up on Wednesday 4/6/22. At 11:00am.I called 5 local companies here in Raymond and not one called me back. Called Boraczek at 8:09 am on Thursday 4/7. They arrived in 35 minutes and pumped my tank. All I can say is awesome operation! Thanks so much George and Michelle!

author: Kristin DD
text: They were amazing.  Kind,  courteous,  informative, and over all LOVED how fantastic, quick,  and responsive to me they were.  I would recommend to anyone this great team!!! Thank you for helping wth the septic main drain replacement.
